sources.summary: As AI factories grow from megawatts to gigawatts, building them takes more than advanced computing. Open standards are helping the industry scale AI infrastructure faster, more efficiently and more reliably. At the Open Compute Project (OCP) Global Summit, taking place in the San Jose McEnery Convention Center, NVIDIA announced new partnerships and contributions aimed at […]
sources.summary_zh: 隨著 AI 工廠從百萬瓦（megawatts）規模成長到十億瓦（gigawatts），建置它們不僅需要先進的運算能力。開放標準正協助產業界更快、更有效率且更可靠地擴充套件 AI 基礎設施。在於聖荷西麥克恩瑞會議中心（San Jose McEnery Convention Center）舉辦的開放運算計畫（Open Compute Project, OCP）全球高峰會上，輝達 宣佈了旨在 […] 的全新合作夥伴關係與貢獻
